rapport_notes: Warm, thorough, and reassuring through a long itemized inventory and an unusual piano question.

evidence_quotes.agenda: Not asked; customer raised the piano concern organically ('is that gonna [cost more]... I don't know that a hundred percent').
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Rep worked through the piano type across several exchanges (asked for a photo, explained what they can/can't move) until it was resolved.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'You only pay after the move is completed... if it actually only took us five or six hours, you only pay for those hours' — covers beats-it/pay-less.

top_strength: Patiently resolved an ambiguous piano-type question over several turns instead of giving a quick brush-off answer.
coaching_note: No damage-coverage or Meet-Your-Mover language was used despite a full itemized inventory call — a natural spot to layer those differentiators in.
